title: Engineering digest
summary: A daily digest of open pull requests, issues and failing builds, with the stale ones flagged.

inspiration.title: Back up n8n workflows to GitHub

stages.title: Read open work
stages.does: Lists open pull requests, bug issues and the latest default-branch build per repository.

stages.title: Age items
stages.does: Computes age in days and the stale flag; DATE is today in UTC and DAYS is stale_after_days.

stages.title: Learn
stages.does: Turns feedback on earlier runs into learning and proposals before the write.
stages.command: python3 skills/routineos/scripts/routineos.py learn --docs snapshot.json --run run.json --out learn

stages.title: Write
stages.does: Applies the run input under the write contract.
stages.command: python3 skills/routineos/scripts/routineos.py write --docs snapshot.json --run run.json --out batches

connectors.label: Code host
connectors.purpose: Read pull requests, issues and build status.
alternatives: An MCP server for your code host
connectors.connect: Add a connector or MCP server with read access to the repositories you list.
